description: This file contains implementation of a custom memory allocator and utility functions related to the 'lwsac' data structure used for managing memory chunks within the libwebsockets project. It provides functions for allocating, extending, referencing, and freeing memory chunks, as well as utility functions for memory alignment and scanning.

methods.name: void lws_list_ptr_insert(lws_list_ptr * head,lws_list_ptr * add,lws_list_ptr_sort_func_t sort_func)
methods.description: Inserts a node into a linked list sorted according to a supplied comparison function.

methods.name: size_t lwsac_align(size_t length)
methods.description: Aligns a size to the platform's pointer size boundary.

methods.name: size_t lwsac_sizeof(int first)
methods.description: Calculates the size of an lwsac structure, optionally including a header.

methods.name: size_t lwsac_get_tail_pos(struct lwsac * lac)
methods.description: Returns the current offset position in an lwsac instance.

methods.name: struct:lwsac * lwsac_get_next(struct lwsac * lac)
methods.description: Returns the next lwsac chunk in the chain.

methods.name: int lwsac_extend(struct lwsac * head,size_t amount)
methods.description: Attempts to extend the current chunk in an lwsac chain by a specified amount.

methods.name: void * _lwsac_use(struct lwsac ** head,size_t ensure,size_t chunk_size,char backfill)
methods.description: Internal function to allocate and optionally backfill memory within the lwsac chain.

methods.name: void * lwsac_use(struct lwsac ** head,size_t ensure,size_t chunk_size)
methods.description: Allocates a chunk of memory from the lwsac chain.

methods.name: void * lwsac_use_backfill(struct lwsac ** head,size_t ensure,size_t chunk_size)
methods.description: Allocates a chunk of memory with potential backfill capability.

methods.name: uint8_t * lwsac_scan_extant(struct lwsac * head,uint8_t * find,size_t len,int nul)
methods.description: Scans through the lwsac chunks to find an existing extant memory block matching a pattern.

methods.name: uint64_t lwsac_total_overhead(struct lwsac * head)
methods.description: Calculates the total overhead in memory used by the lwsac chain.

methods.name: void * lwsac_use_zero(struct lwsac ** head,size_t ensure,size_t chunk_size)
methods.description: Allocates a chunk of memory and zeroes it out.

methods.name: void lwsac_free(struct lwsac ** head)
methods.description: Frees all chunks in an lwsac chain.

methods.name: void lwsac_info(struct lwsac * head)
methods.description: Logs information about the lwsac chain, such as total size and block count.

methods.name: uint64_t lwsac_total_alloc(struct lwsac * head)
methods.description: Returns the total allocated size for the entire lwsac chain.

methods.name: void lwsac_reference(struct lwsac * head)
methods.description: Increments the reference count for an lwsac chain.

methods.name: void lwsac_unreference(struct lwsac ** head)
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and frees the chain if no longer referenced.

methods.name: void lwsac_detach(struct lwsac ** head)
methods.description: Marks an lwsac chain as detached, potentially freeing it if no longer referenced.

ctags.name: _lwsac_use
ctags.pattern: /^_lwsac_use(struct lwsac **head, size_t ensure, size_t chunk_size, char backfill)$/

ctags.name: lwsac_scan_extant
ctags.pattern: /^lwsac_scan_extant(struct lwsac *head, uint8_t *find, size_t len, int nul)$/
